subject.title: feat: align native macOS chat with the web chat capability set

question: Should the full native macOS chat enable and persist assistant reasoning and tool activity by default for existing users?
rationale: Current native behavior hides traces, while this PR changes the upgrade default and adds a persistent preference; source correctness cannot determine the intended privacy, complexity, and parity tradeoff.

options.title: Preserve the existing default
options.body: Default traces off while keeping the toolbar toggle, so upgrades do not expose additional assistant internals unless users opt in.

options.title: Adopt web-parity default-on
options.body: Keep traces enabled by default and explicitly accept the upgrade behavior after targeted product and signed-app proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve the existing default
recommendation.body: Default traces off while keeping the toolbar toggle, so upgrades do not expose additional assistant internals unless users opt in.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available product-direction and implementation owner for the native-chat parity decision.
